title: Faith That Stands When Life Shakes
opening: Faith is confidence in God's character and trust in His Word, even when circumstances have not changed yet.
points: Build your confidence on what God has spoken, not only on what you can see.
Keep praying and obeying while you wait; faith is active trust, not passivity.
Let your words and choices reflect hope without pretending that difficulties do not exist.
reflection: What promise in Scripture can guide one decision you face today?
prayer: Father, strengthen my trust in You. Help me to walk by faith, remain obedient, and hold firmly to Your Word. Amen.
